title: Move the retry-cap and retry-head permit wiring out of engram_host_adapter.rs into the retry schedule modules
outcome: Move the retry-cap and retry-head permit wiring out of engram_host_adapter.rs into the retry schedule modules
acceptance: The retry slot and permit decisions live in engram_retry_schedule.rs or engram_admission_retry.rs, and engram_host_adapter.rs only calls them. The move is pure (no behaviour change) and the existing retry tests pass unchanged.
